about.title: ABOUT
about.paragraph1: Hi! My name is Renato, I'm a Software Engineer graduate from Anhanguera and work as a Software Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst with over 2 years of experience in the technology field.
about.paragraph2: In my daily work, I perform manual and automated testing, scenario documentation, task refinement, and bug report creation, contributing to the delivery of more reliable and stable digital products. I have experience with test automation using Playwright and Cypress.
about.paragraph3: I also have knowledge in Web Development, which gives me a broad view of the software development cycle and facilitates collaboration between the product, development, and quality areas.
